bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
test "$(realpath "$root")" = /home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot || exit 70
systemctl --user is-active --quiet gace-userbot-verify.service || exit 71
systemctl --user is-enabled --quiet gace-userbot-verify.service || exit 72
socket="$root/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.sock"
for i in $(seq 1 20); do test -S "$socket" && break; sleep 1; done
test -S "$socket" || exit 73
(cd "$root/scripts" && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -B userbot_test_client.py health) || exit 74
(cd "$root/scripts" && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -B userbot_test_client.py bug_report_inbox_provision) || exit 75
test -f "$root/deploy/secrets/bug_report_userbot_account.txt" || exit 76
test "$(stat -c %a "$root/deploy/secrets/bug_report_userbot_account.txt")" = 600 || exit 77
echo USERBOT_HEALTH_AND_PROVISION_PASS
